description.zh: 默认每 10 分钟有效游玩时间保存，并在从 Esc 返回主菜单或退出游戏前保存。身上和箱子里的物品随原生战役保存；读档后按游戏规则出现在列车或起点。游戏或 UE4SS 更新后自动保存会停用，等待 Mod 更新。
description.en: Saves every 10 minutes of active play by default, and before leaving through Esc. Uses native campaign saves for carried items and container contents; reloads spawn you on the train or at the starting point under the game's own rules. Autosave stops after a game or UE4SS update until the mod is updated.
